title: Adhyardhaśatikā Prajñāpāramitā [Adhyardhaśatikāprajñāpāramitāsūtra]
Remarks Chinese translation: T08n220(10) - This refers to the tenth division of the Mahāprañāpāramitāsūtra. However, I'm uncertain whether the volume number 08 is correct, as I couldn't confirm it anywhere. Moreover, I find the reference to T08n0244 not entirely convincing.
